# Bypasses (seeded)

Each line marked `seeded: <rule id>` (or the line after a `seeded below:` comment) is a defect an
independent attacker slipped past an earlier version of the red team. Every one must now be
caught at that line, and nothing else in this tree may be reported. `bypass_clean` beside it holds
the safe forms and the false alarms the same attackers found, which must stay quiet.

The credentials here are made up for the tests and work nowhere.
